F019.explanation_en: Combines the ability to execute vendor payments with control over posting periods.
F019.consequence_en: A user may process payments while also influencing when related transactions can be posted, increasing the risk of unauthorized transactions being concealed or shifted between periods.
F019.mitigating_controls_en: Independent review of payment runs; restricted period-opening authority; review of period changes and payment logs.
F019.review_guidance_en: Confirm whether the user genuinely requires both AP01 and FI06. Verify that payment execution and period control cannot reasonably be separated.

M002.display_name: Production Confirmation vs. Production Order Management
M002.explanation_en: Combines confirmation of production with creation, modification or release of production orders.
M002.consequence_en: A user may control both the production instruction and its reported execution, reducing independent verification of production quantities and activities.
M002.mitigating_controls_en: Independent review of production confirmations; variance monitoring; separate approval or release responsibility where feasible.
M002.review_guidance_en: Confirm whether the user must both manage production orders and confirm their execution. Check whether operational responsibilities justify PP01 + PP02.

P003.display_name: Vendor Invoice Processing vs. Vendor Payments
P003.explanation_en: Combines processing of vendor invoices with execution or clearing of vendor payments.
P003.consequence_en: A user could enter or modify a vendor invoice and subsequently initiate or complete payment, enabling unauthorized or fraudulent disbursements.
P003.mitigating_controls_en: Payment approval workflow; independent payment release; invoice approval controls; periodic exception review.
P003.review_guidance_en: High-priority SoD conflict. Challenge any requirement for AP01 + AP02. Verify that invoice entry and payment execution are independently controlled.

P005.display_name: Goods Movements vs. Purchase Order Processing
P005.explanation_en: Combines execution of inventory movements with creation or modification of purchase orders.
P005.consequence_en: A user may influence purchasing documentation and related inventory movements, reducing independent control over ordered and received goods.
P005.mitigating_controls_en: Independent PO approval; goods-receipt monitoring; three-way matching; review of PO and goods-movement exceptions.
P005.review_guidance_en: Confirm whether MM05 + PR02 is required by the user's role. Determine whether ordering and goods movement responsibilities can be separated.

P013.display_name: Material Master Maintenance vs. Purchase Order Processing
P013.explanation_en: Combines maintenance of material master data with creation or modification of purchase orders.
P013.consequence_en: A user could change material-related master data and subsequently use that data in purchasing transactions, increasing the risk of manipulated or inappropriate purchases.
P013.mitigating_controls_en: Controlled master-data workflow; independent master-data approval; PO approval; monitoring of sensitive material changes.
P013.review_guidance_en: Verify the business need for MM06 + PR02. Pay particular attention to users responsible for both master data and operational purchasing.

P019.display_name: Goods Movements vs. Purchase Order Release
P019.explanation_en: Combines execution of goods movements with authority to release purchase orders.
P019.consequence_en: A user may approve purchasing activity and perform related inventory movements, weakening independent control over procurement and receipt activities.
P019.mitigating_controls_en: Independent purchasing review; release strategy; goods-receipt exception monitoring; periodic access review.
P019.review_guidance_en: Confirm whether the same user requires MM05 + PR04. Evaluate whether PO approval and goods-movement execution can be segregated.

P036.display_name: Material Master Maintenance vs. Purchase Requisition Processing
P036.explanation_en: Combines maintenance of material master data with creation or modification of purchase requisitions.
P036.consequence_en: A user may manipulate material data and initiate purchasing demand based on those changes, reducing independent oversight of procurement initiation.
P036.mitigating_controls_en: Master-data approval; requisition approval workflow; monitoring of sensitive master-data changes.
P036.review_guidance_en: Confirm whether MM06 + PR07 is necessary. Review users who both maintain material data and initiate purchasing requirements.

P059.display_name: Purchase Order Processing vs. Purchase Order Release
P059.explanation_en: Combines creation or modification of purchase orders with authority to release those same purchase orders.
P059.consequence_en: A user may create or change a purchase order and independently approve it, bypassing the maker-checker principle.
P059.mitigating_controls_en: SAP release strategy; approval by an independent approver; release and change monitoring; approval thresholds.
P059.review_guidance_en: High-priority SoD conflict. Users should normally not hold both PR02 + PR04 unless an effective independent control exists.

S003.display_name: Customer Confirmation vs. Sales Order Processing
S003.explanation_en: Combines customer-related confirmation activities with sales-order creation or modification.
S003.consequence_en: A user may control multiple steps of customer transaction processing, increasing the risk of unauthorized or inappropriate sales transactions.
S003.mitigating_controls_en: Independent sales review; transaction monitoring; approval for sensitive customer transactions.
S003.review_guidance_en: Confirm whether the user's responsibilities genuinely require SD01 + SD05 and whether an independent downstream review exists.

S004.display_name: Customer Receivables Processing vs. Customer Confirmation
S004.explanation_en: Combines customer receivables or document processing with customer confirmation activities.
S004.consequence_en: A user may influence both financial customer documents and related confirmation activities, increasing the risk of unauthorized adjustments or concealed transactions.
S004.mitigating_controls_en: Independent review of receivable adjustments; approval of sensitive customer changes; periodic exception reporting.
S004.review_guidance_en: Verify the business requirement for AR07 + SD01. Review whether customer accounting and confirmation responsibilities can be separated.

S028.display_name: Customer Receivables Processing vs. Sales Order Processing
S028.explanation_en: Combines customer accounting or document processing with creation or modification of sales orders.
S028.consequence_en: A user may influence both the commercial transaction and related financial records, increasing the risk of inappropriate or concealed customer transactions.
S028.mitigating_controls_en: Independent review of sales and receivables adjustments; approval controls; exception monitoring.
S028.review_guidance_en: High-priority cross-functional conflict. Confirm why the user requires both AR07 + SD05 and identify the independent control covering the combination.

AP01.explanation_en: Ability to execute and manage outgoing vendor payments, payment runs, clearing and related settlement activities.
AP01.review_guidance_en: Grant only to users responsible for payment execution or clearing. Review carefully together with invoice processing and other activities capable of creating or modifying liabilities.

AP02.explanation_en: Ability to create, change, park, post or otherwise process vendor invoices, credit memos and related financial documents.
AP02.review_guidance_en: Confirm that vendor invoice processing is part of the user's responsibilities. Review especially when combined with payment execution.

AR07.explanation_en: Ability to process customer invoices, credit memos, clearing and other accounting documents related to customer receivables.
AR07.review_guidance_en: Confirm that the user requires operational access to customer accounting. Review combinations with sales-order or customer-related processing.

FI06.explanation_en: Ability to control posting periods relevant to logistics and financial postings.
FI06.review_guidance_en: Restrict to users responsible for period-close activities. Verify that operational transaction processing is appropriately separated from period control.

MM05.explanation_en: Ability to execute inventory movements such as goods receipts, goods issues and stock transfers.
MM05.review_guidance_en: Confirm that inventory posting is required for the user's operational role. Review combinations with purchasing creation or approval activities.

MM06.explanation_en: Ability to create, change, delete or otherwise maintain material master and batch-related information.
MM06.review_guidance_en: Restrict maintenance access to authorized master-data responsibilities. Review combinations that allow the user to initiate or approve transactions using the maintained data.

PP01.explanation_en: Ability to record confirmations against production or process orders, including reported production activities and quantities.
PP01.review_guidance_en: Confirm that the user is responsible for recording production execution. Review combinations with production-order creation, modification or release.

PP02.explanation_en: Ability to create, change, release or perform mass processing of production and process orders.
PP02.review_guidance_en: Confirm that production-order management is part of the user's responsibilities. Review carefully when the user can also confirm execution.

PR02.explanation_en: Ability to create or change purchase orders and perform related purchase-order processing.
PR02.review_guidance_en: Confirm that the user requires operational purchasing access. Review combinations with PO release, material-master maintenance and goods movements.

PR04.explanation_en: Ability to release or approve purchase orders.
PR04.review_guidance_en: Limit to authorized approvers. Verify appropriate approval authority and review users who can also create or modify purchase orders.

PR07.explanation_en: Ability to create or modify purchase requisitions and initiate purchasing demand.
PR07.review_guidance_en: Confirm that requisition creation or maintenance is required. Review combinations with sensitive master-data maintenance.

SD01.explanation_en: Ability to perform defined customer confirmation and manual customer-document activities.
SD01.review_guidance_en: Confirm the specific operational requirement for this access and review combinations with receivables or sales-order processing.

SD05.explanation_en: Ability to create, change or otherwise process sales orders and related sales documents.
SD05.review_guidance_en: Confirm that sales-order maintenance is required. Review combinations with customer receivables and customer confirmation activities.

terms.Activity: A grouping of SAP transactions that represents a business capability or sensitive business function. An activity is not necessarily a risk by itself.
terms.Segregation of Duties Risk: A conflict created when a user has access to two or more incompatible activities that together provide excessive control over a business process.
terms.Risk Consequence: The business impact that could occur if the conflicting access is misused or an error is not independently detected.
terms.Mitigating Control: A documented and independently performed control that reduces the risk when conflicting access cannot reasonably be removed.
terms.Review Guidance: Practical guidance for the access reviewer describing what should be challenged or verified before the access or SoD conflict is accepted.
terms.Local Notes: Organization-specific information such as local process exceptions, system limitations, plant-specific responsibilities, compensating controls or documented rationale.
